google-play.name: Google Play
google-play.purpose: App distribution and updates. Google may collect install, device and crash diagnostics (Android vitals) under its own policy.

applovin.name: AppLovin MAX
applovin.purpose: Ad mediation: requests, shows and measures ads, and shows the consent form in regions that require it. Uses the advertising ID, IP address, device and ad interaction data.

admob.name: Google AdMob
admob.purpose: Ads served through AppLovin MAX and Google's consent form (User Messaging Platform). Uses the advertising ID, IP address, device and ad interaction data.

unity-ads.name: Unity Ads
unity-ads.purpose: Ads served through AppLovin MAX. Uses the advertising ID, IP address, device and ad interaction data.

google-play-billing.name: Google Play Billing
google-play-billing.purpose: Processes in-app purchases; payment details stay with Google.

apps.name: Snake Odyssey 3D: Eat It All
apps.local: Game progress and settings (levels, coins, unlocked skins, sound options) are saved only on your device.
